**"Defect"** means any condition, fault, or failure in the Track Assets that does not comply with the Maintenance Standards or the requirements of this Agreement.

**"Initial Term"** means the period commencing on the Commencement Date and expiring on 14 August 2026, unless terminated earlier in accordance with clause 13.

**"Maintenance Plan"** means the document titled "Northern Coastal Rail Maintenance Plan – FY2024" provided by the Principal to the Contractor prior to the Commencement Date, as amended from time to time in accordance with clause 5.6.

**"Maintenance Standards"** means the standards, specifications, procedures, and guidelines set out in the Maintenance Plan and the RSSI, as amended from time to time.

**"Network"** has the meaning given in Background A.

**"RSSI"** means the Rail Safety Standards Interface documents published by the Rail Industry Safety and Standards Board (RISSB) as in force from time to time.

**"Services"** means the track maintenance services described in clause 2 and Schedule 1.

**"Track Assets"** means the permanent way assets, including rails, sleepers, fastenings, ballast, turnouts, level crossings, and associated drainage, owned or operated by NCRMG on the Network.

**2. Scope of Services**

2.1  The Contractor shall provide the Services to NCRMG at the locations and in accordance with the schedule set out in Schedule 1.

2.2  The Services comprise the following principal activities:

(a)  routine inspections of Track Assets in accordance with the frequencies specified in the Maintenance Plan;

(b)  corrective maintenance to rectify Defects identified during inspections or reported by NCRMG;

(c)  emergency response to track incidents, including derailments, signal failures affecting the permanent way, and severe weather events, on a 24/7 call-out basis;

(d)  vegetation management within the rail corridor to the extent required to maintain sight lines and drainage; and

2.4  The Contractor shall not subcontract any part of the Services without the prior written consent of NCRMG, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld. Any approved subcontractor must be named in the Contractor's quality management system and hold all required accreditations.
